name: Cache-Aside Read Caching
summary: Introduce a cache-aside strategy to reduce repeated reads against hot data stores and lower end-to-end latency.

use_when.message: Database p95 latency is elevated; caching can reduce read pressure.

avoid_when.message: High error rate suggests instability; address correctness/reliability before introducing caching complexity.

solutions: Cache hot read paths with TTL and explicit cache invalidation strategy
Add request coalescing to prevent cache stampedes
Instrument cache hit rate and tail latency impact
